instruction: A massive two-handed warhammer with a blocky dark-iron head wrapped in leather-bound grips. Deep-cut runes across the head and haft blaze with molten orange-blue emissive light that seems to pulse from within the metal. Faint glowing embers drift from the seams, casting a warm halo around the otherwise heavy stone-and-steel weapon.
